On ℝ³ with Θ = dz − y dx, ξ = ∂_z and π_V = Θ∧ι_ξ, the 0-form f = z is horizontal. Yet d_q f = q⁻¹dz + (1−q⁻¹)Θ ≠ q⁻¹dz. The formula post-composes π_V, but the proof pre-composes it (d∘π_V); the two differ.
